features.description: Fandom-targeted fan-fiction scraper: given a novel/film, discover works, judge relevance, gate prose, dedup, and persist a KB-ready corpus
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s5): 37 unit tests green. Hexagonal: domain/models/fanfic.py + domain/fanfic_quality.py (pure, stdlib-only) behind FanficSourcePort/AliasExpanderPort/CorpusSinkPort; WattpadSource + WikipediaAliasExpander + JsonlCorpusSink adapters; FanficHarvester service; `story-engine harvest` CLI. make check green (44 tests, mypy 55 files).

features.description: A live harvest produces a non-empty corpus of real fan-fiction prose with chapter structure
features.verification: uv run python -c "import json,pathlib,sys; m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('data/raw/fanfic/the-witcher/manifest.json').read_text()); sys.exit(0 if m['story_count']>=1 and m['total_words']>=1000 else 1)"
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s5): `story-engine harvest 'The Witcher' --max-stories 5 --max-chapters 3` -> 18 aliases expanded, 20 candidates, 1 work / 3 chapters / 4,073 words of genuine Witcher prose (Kaer Morhen, Vesemir, Drowners). stories.jsonl + manifest.json written UTF-8 to gitignored data/raw/fanfic/.

features.description: Harvest yield and precision are acceptable: search spreads across the alias set, ambiguous titles disambiguate, and kept works are genuinely fan fiction of the requested fandom
features.verification: uv run python -c "import json,pathlib,sys; m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('data/raw/fanfic/titanic/manifest.json').read_text()); sys.exit(0 if m['story_count']>=10 and m['total_words']>=20000 else 1)"
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s5): Titanic (movie) -> 10 works / 21 chapters / 23,830 words; Dexter (novel) -> 4 works / 13 chapters / 19,104 words. Analyst review: 6/6 Dexter and 8/8 inspected Titanic works are genuine fanfic of the right fandom; 0 disclaimer leaks corpus-wide. Fixes: round-robin alias search, Wikipedia-search title resolution ('Titanic (1997 film)' — films disambiguate by YEAR so suffix guessing could never reach it), tag-key + word-boundary alias matching, explicit-declaration rule, mature exclusion, read/vote floors, sentence-level disclaimer stripping.

features.description: IV&V: the scraper's reliability layer, truncation provenance, and boilerplate safety are covered by tests that would fail if the behaviour regressed
features.verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/adapters/test_http_util.py tests/unit/adapters/test_jsonl_sink.py tests/unit/services/test_fanfic_harvest.py tests/unit/domain/test_fanfic_quality.py -q
features.evidence: 2026-07-25 (s6): independent verification pass, posture 'assume the scraper is incorrect until evidence proves otherwise'. Found and fixed 4 defects, each proven by executing code: (1) strip_boilerplate deleted real narration - 5/5 realistic prose lines destroyed, e.g. 'Like a knife, the cold cut through him.'; (2) chapters silently dropped leaving works truncated with no marker - live wattpad:864850 shipped starting at CHAPTER 2 - fixed via corpus schema 1.1->1.2 adding chapters_dropped{non_prose,duplicate,is_partial}; (3) JsonlCorpusSink recomputed branch points with its own default so --max-branch-options 2 printed 2 options but wrote 3 to disk - fixed by threading the ceiling through CorpusSinkPort; (4) <script>/<style> bodies leaked into prose, caught by a new test. Suite 237->286: new test_http_util.py (22 tests) covers the retry engine which previously had ZERO tests; killed a false positive (test_respects_max_stories asserted len<=2, also satisfied by returning zero). Root cause of the blind spot: fixtures defaulted to chapters=1, making intra-work dedup structurally unobservable. make check green, 5 consecutive stable runs incl. 2 randomized.
